method: Automated bag-centroid continuity proxy for frames 0-4. This checks that detection and first contact do not teleport the bag and that the frame-3 protective pull approaches frame 4 smoothly. Hand contact, gaze and expression still require visual semantic review.

beats.label: Neutral
beats.visual_requirement: Neutral standing pose; no reaction has started.

beats.label: Detect poke
beats.visual_requirement: Eyes snap viewer-right; bag-side shoulder twitches; viewer-right hand approaches without contact; viewer-left hand remains on strap.

beats.label: First contact / recoil
beats.visual_requirement: Small restrained recoil; viewer-right fingertips first contact the rabbit or bag; bag is not pulled yet; expression is surprised.

beats.label: Protective pull begins
beats.visual_requirement: Viewer-right hand closes and begins a small inward-up pull; viewer-left hand starts rising; surprise changes to wary attention.

beats.label: Guard start
beats.visual_requirement: Established protective guard pose without a motion pop.

semantic_review_items: Frame 1 gaze and shoulder twitch read as detecting a viewer-right poke.
Frame 1 viewer-right hand has a visible gap from bag and rabbit.
Frame 2 shows first hand contact and restrained recoil without pulling the bag.
Frame 3 closes the protective hand and starts the inward-up pull.
Frames 0-4 contain exactly one bag, one rabbit and one continuous strap.
No external hand, poke mark, effect, text, shadow or additional prop appears.
